questions.question: Describe your work testing software for the Navy System for Naval Target Control. How did you translate software requirements into test scripts and verification evidence?
You have experience troubleshooting software defects and verifying fixes. Walk us through a particularly difficult issue you identified, how you isolated it, and how you confirmed the resolution.
This role requires hands-on Java or C++ development. What C++ or Java applications, components, or test utilities have you developed, and what was your specific contribution?
Tell us about the proprietary testing tools you modified at Conduent. What inefficiency did you address, what changes did you make, and how did you assess the outcome?
Describe the automation testing you set up for the five stand-alone programs on the JTCG/ME contract. Which tools and languages did you use, and how was the automation maintained?
What experience do you have with SQL Server and relational-data design or administration? Please describe the setup and maintenance work you performed for the JWS contract.
How have you used Jira, Microsoft Test Management, Team Foundation Server, or similar tools to manage defects, test execution, requirements traceability, and release readiness?

This position leads multiple Agile teams and manages release plans. Based on your release and hot-fix experience, how would you coordinate testing, defect prioritization, and stakeholder communication when delivery priorities change?

Describe your experience leading or mentoring others, including your Army Team Leader responsibilities or any technical guidance you have provided in software teams. How did you maintain accountability and morale?

The role supports complex systems and values familiarity with real-time, embedded, ITS, or control-system domains. What did your work on Naval Target Control or other projects teach you about testing systems with hardware, timing, or operational constraints?
